For applicants with Ph.D. degree, normal duration of Ph.D. program would be counted towards experience (maximum 3 years). Tech./B.E.) in Computer Science/Computer Applications or allied fields with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA with 5-year relevant experience after degree OR B. Tech./B.E. or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Science or allied fields with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA with 3-year relevant experience after degree. For applicants with full time Master's Degree, normal duration of Master's program would be counted towards experience (max 2 years).

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 1 for Technical Officer [Discipline: CCS] and 2 for Junior Technical Superintendent [Discipline: CSE].

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technical Officer [Discipline: CCS]: B.Tech. / B.E. or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering/Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied fields with minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade point average with relevant experience of six years after the qualifying degree in Level 6 OR three years' experience in Level 7 and above or equivalent. For applicants with full time M.Tech./M.E. or equivalent Degree, normal duration of Master's program would be counted towards experience (maximum 2 years). For applicants with Ph.D. degree, normal duration of Ph.D. program would be counted towards experience (maximum 3 years). Junior Technical Superintendent [Discipline: CSE]: 3 Year Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering or allied fields with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA with 06-year relevant experience after diploma OR Bachelor Degree (other than B. Tech./B.E.) in Computer Science/Computer Applications or allied fields with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA with 5-year relevant experience after degree OR B. Tech./B.E. or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Science or allied fields with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA with 3-year relevant experience after degree. For applicants with full time Master's Degree, normal duration of Master's program would be counted towards experience (max 2 years).

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Technical Officer: Upper Age Limit: 42 Years Junior Technical Superintendent: Upper Age Limit: 34 Years Age Relaxation: For SC & ST Category – 5 Years against reserved posts only. For OBC [NCL] Category - 3 Years against reserved posts only. ESM and PwBD applicants will be given age relaxation as per Government of India norms. Current Regular employees of IIT Dharwad will get an additional age relaxation of 5 years. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Dharwad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Dharwad recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Dharwad Technical Officer / Junior Technical Superintendent posts is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Officer / Junior Technical Superintendent posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Technical Officer and Junior Technical Superintendent positions at IIT Dharwad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Officer post, candidates need a B.Tech./B.E. or equivalent in CSE/ECE or allied fields with relevant experience, or M.Tech./M.E. or Ph.D. in a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Junior Technical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The Junior Technical Superintendent post is offered at Level 6 (7th CPC) as per the IIT Dharwad recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official IIT Dharwad website for these recruitment opportunities.

faq.question: Q7. Does IIT Dharwad offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, IIT Dharwad offers age relaxation for SC/ST (5 years) and OBC (NCL) (3 years) categories, as well as for ESM and PwBD applicants as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Dharwad recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes Written Tests, an Interview, a Skill Test, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any experience required for the Junior Technical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Yes, depending on the educational qualification (Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, or B.Tech./B.E.), relevant experience of 3 to 6 years is required for the Junior Technical Superintendent post.
